name: ISPO Impact Foundation grants
summary: Annual grants in four sizes (micro to impact) for non-profit organisations, clubs and teams. One of two funding categories covers nature conservation and environmental stewardship connected to sport and outdoor recreation; the other covers inclusive participation.

amount.note: Four tiers: micro up to 2,000, seed up to 10,000, momentum up to 30,000, impact up to 100,000

eligibility.rule: Registered not-for-profit, or for Micro Donations a bank account in its name plus one listed proof

documents: One or two references, depending on grant size
Predicted project impact table, except for Micro Donations
Overview of last year's organisational budget, for Momentum and Impact grants
Project budget including expected other funding

deadline.quote: We will be accepting applications from 1-30 June 2026.

applicant_types.quote: We can only accept applications from registered non-profit organisations, clubs and teams.

geography.quote: We will accept applications from any every geographical region.

window.quote: Sign up to our newsletter to be the first to know when our 2027 funding round will take place.

eligibility.quote: For organisations applying for micro grants, we are aware that some may be too small to be registered as non profit or similar. In this instance, we would like to see at least a bank account in the organisation’s name plus one of the following:

after_award.quote: Seed Grants will receive 50% of the funding requested immediately and 50% once the project is halfway through, the first instalment has mostly been spent, and on receipt of a satisfactory interim report. We will also require a final report once the project has come to an end.
